body.asks: The author's ask of 2026-11-11: a reader more open-ended than a list, each holon drawn at the size its component may take, a number as a small widget, a histogram, the raised things that matter most, a timeline; fitting itself to the room, a widget hosting its sub-widgets where a slice holds slices, a list where there is none; interactive; a little of it first, as a live monitor of the ongoing work.

What Fable found reading the git reader, to be mended: every read spawns git three times, so a read costs about 150 ms and a whole minutes, wanting one long-lived cat-file and the facet looked at first; an unborn HEAD throws; an annotated tag reads as a blob, to be peeled to its commit; a folder that is no repository gives four types and no error; ref and type ids by name collide across repositories, waiting on a root; a submodule's entry holds what is not there; the tip is HEAD's tree only by order; all() spawns once per step, where git log and ls-tree would do in two; a moving ref shows no new version; and Source is said in glass's own format's words.
